meta.title: IP Lookup - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Look up any IP address to find country, city, ISP, and coordinates. Auto-detects your own IP on load.
ipEnterAddress: Enter IP address (leave blank for your IP)
steps_ip-lookup_1Desc: Type an IP address to look up, or leave blank to detect your own IP automatically. Your IP is detected on page load for immediate results.
steps_ip-lookup_2Desc: Results show country, city, ISP, ASN, coordinates, and timezone. All processing happens in your browser — no personal data is stored or tracked.
steps_ip-lookup_3Desc: Click "View on Google Maps" to see the IP's approximate geographic location. Copy any field by clicking it for use in logs or documentation.
desc: Look up any IP address to find country, city, ISP, and coordinates. Auto-detects your own IP on load.
ipNetworkError: Network error: unable to reach the lookup service. Please try again later
ipTimeout: Lookup timed out. Please try again later
ipNoCoords: No coordinate information available for this IP
